name: Complex
cot
result.informal_description: For any complex number $ z $, the cotangent function is defined as $ \cot(z) = \frac{\cos z}{\sin z} $, where $ \cos z $ and $ \sin z $ denote the complex cosine and sine functions respectively.

name: Complex
abs_re_div_norm_le_one
result.value:
:=
  if hz : z = 0 then by simp [hz, zero_le_one]
  else by simp_rw [abs_div, abs_norm, div_le_iff₀ (norm_pos_iff.mpr hz), one_mul, abs_re_le_norm]
result.informal_name: Absolute Value of Real Part Divided by Norm is at Most One
result.informal_description: For any complex number $ z $, the absolute value of its real part divided by its norm satisfies $ \left| \frac{\operatorname{Re}(z)}{\|z\|} \right| \leq 1 $. This follows from the definition of the complex norm $ \|z\| = \sqrt{\operatorname{Re}(z)^2 + \operatorname{Im}(z)^2} $, which ensures that $ |\operatorname{Re}(z)| \leq \|z\| $. Equality holds if and only if $ z $ is purely real and nonzero.

name: Real
cot
result.informal_description: The function maps a real number $ x $ to the real part of the complex cotangent $ \cot(x) $, which is defined as $ \frac{\cos x}{\sin x} $.

name: Complex
tan_ofReal_re
result.informal_name: Real part of complex tangent equals real tangent
result.informal_description: For any real number $x$, the real part of the complex tangent function evaluated at $x$ is equal to the real tangent function evaluated at $x$, i.e., $\text{Re}(\tan(x)) = \tan(x)$.

name: Complex
reCLM_norm
result.value:
:=
  le_antisymm (LinearMap.mkContinuous_norm_le _ zero_le_one _) <|
    calc
      1 = ‖reCLM 1‖ := by simp
      _ ≤ ‖reCLM‖ := unit_le_opNorm _ _ (by simp)
result.informal_name: Operator Norm of Real Part Map: $\| \text{Re} \| = 1$
result.informal_description: The operator norm of the continuous real-linear map from the complex numbers $\mathbb{C}$ to the real numbers $\mathbb{R}$ that sends each complex number $z$ to its real part $\text{Re}(z)$ is equal to 1.
